subject: ROOT SCHEDULE: freeze at 05:45 for C6m integration
body: By 05:45 every agent reaches a gate-green stable point, posts STABLE with source hashes, and stops editing shared files (gpu/metal/**, gpu/tests/**, translator checkouts). From 05:45 root alone runs the gates on the combined tree, commits, re-pins the translator (root merges references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin edits into gpu/build/metal2vulkan), rebuilds the host and iOS libraries, builds and packages C6m, and computes the host fps model. After 05:45, work only in private copies or your own gpu/build/<dir>, and post patches for after C6m. If a hunk isn't gate-green by 05:45, back it out to your last stable point, or tell root which hunks to exclude.
